item.description:
Secretary of State Rubio says Ukraine currently lacks access to the U.S. military’s Starshield satellite service, but HAS requested it for deep strikes inside Russia. That hasn’t been approved yet.
More, he denies Washington ordered restrictions on commercial Starlink.

item.description:
President Trump says he is holding off on further sanctions against Russia to preserve Ukraine peace negotiations.
As previously noted, he says Moscow is providing little assistance to Iran and accuses Zelenskyy of disrupting global diesel markets by striking Russian refineries.
item.content:encoded:
@faytuksnetwork
